phase_1.title: Phase 1 · Dragunov SVD Trigger Release & Ignition Drive
phase_1.description: Pulling the trigger disengages the sear, freeing the spring-driven hammer or striker to impact the 7.62×54mmR primer.

phase_2.title: Phase 2 · 390 MPa Chamber Pressure Rise
phase_2.description: The propellant charge ignites inside the locked chamber, driving peak pressure to 390 MPa while sealing the cartridge case against the breech.

phase_3.title: Phase 3 · 620 mm Barrel Engraving & Acceleration
phase_3.description: The projectile engages the 4-groove bore and accelerates to 830 m/s (3300 J).

phase_4.title: Phase 4 · Short-Stroke Pulse & Operating Impulse
phase_4.description: Once chamber pressure decays safely, independent short-stroke piston delivers a clean impulse while isolating heat forward of the receiver.

phase_5.title: Phase 5 · Spent Case Extraction & Ejection
phase_5.description: The extractor pulls the fired brass clear of the chamber and pivots it out the ejection port while the recoil spring compresses.

phase_6.title: Phase 6 · Next-Round Stripping & Breech Lockup
phase_6.description: Driven forward by the recoil spring, the breech strips the next round from the 10-round supply and locks solidly into battery.

phase_7.title: Phase 7 · Disconnector Handoff & Sear Reset
phase_7.description: Releasing the trigger hands control cleanly back to the primary sear, leaving the Dragunov SVD staged for its 30 RPM (Practical Semi-Auto) cadence.

zh.headline: 德拉贡诺夫 SVD 半自动狙击步枪：1963 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: 叶夫根尼·德拉贡诺夫设计的 SVD 开创了现代“班组精准射手步枪（DMR）”先河：与 AK 截然不同，其采用独立短行程活塞与轻量化三突笋旋转枪机大幅降低往复质心扰动，标配 4×24 PSO-1 视距测距瞄准镜在 800 米内快速压制火力点。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：Dragunov SVD 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 1963 年问世的 德拉贡诺夫 SVD 半自动狙击步枪 由苏联伊热夫斯克机械厂（Izhmash）主导研制，定位为经典的半自动精准射手步枪。SVD 于 1963 年正式装备苏军机械化步兵排，成为全球首支以“排级延伸火力”而非孤狼狙击为编制定位的半自动狙击步枪。
叶夫根尼·德拉贡诺夫设计的 SVD 开创了现代“班组精准射手步枪（DMR）”先河：与 AK 截然不同，其采用独立短行程活塞与轻量化三突笋旋转枪机大幅降低往复质心扰动，标配 4×24 PSO-1 视距测距瞄准镜在 800 米内快速压制火力点。 整件装备总长 1,225 mm（镂空层压木托 + 消焰器）、空重 4.3 kg，成为同期狙击步枪领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。1963 年，苏联伊热夫斯克机械厂（Izhmash）推出了划时代的德拉贡诺夫 SVD 半自动狙击步枪。SVD 于 1963 年正式装备苏军机械化步兵排，成为全球首支以“排级延伸火力”而非孤狼狙击为编制定位的半自动狙击步枪。 它的核心设计聚焦于独立短行程活塞与弹簧回位顶杆彻底解耦机匣前部振源，精度远超长行程导气步枪，奠定了其在狙击步枪发展史中的经典地位。
acts.focusPartLabel: 主体机匣与闭锁承力框架

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: 德拉贡诺夫 SVD 半自动狙击步枪 的机械灵魂在于其「短行程导气活塞 · 三突笋旋转闭锁枪机 + 两档导气调节器」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，独立短行程活塞瞬时脉冲撞击枪机框，将热负荷与振源隔离在机匣前方，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用发蓝锻钢与油润精选胡桃木/桦木托精加工而成。铣削轻量化钢机匣配三突笋旋转闭锁，承受 7.62×54mmR 凸缘弹高压且耐泥沙严寒，在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。德拉贡诺夫 SVD 半自动狙击步枪 采用短行程导气活塞 · 三突笋旋转闭锁枪机 + 两档导气调节器。在每个击发周期中，独立短行程活塞瞬时脉冲撞击枪机框，将热负荷与振源隔离在机匣前方。借助发蓝锻钢与油润精选胡桃木/桦木托工艺与高强度配合，实现了铣削轻量化钢机匣配三突笋旋转闭锁，承受 7.62×54mmR 凸缘弹高压且耐泥沙严寒。
acts.focusPartLabel: 高强度闭锁枪机头与抽壳钩

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 7.62×54mmR 弹药规格与 620 mm 镀铬精密冷锻 · 4 条右旋膛线（1:240 mm 缠距），最高工作膛压约 390 MPa，可赋予弹头 830 m/s 的出膛初速与 3,300 J 动能，有效作用距离达 800 米。
内膛技术特点方面，1970 年代起由 1:320 mm 改为 1:240 mm 缠距以兼顾 7N1 狙击弹与曳光穿甲弹。同时，PSO-1 侧装 4×24 瞄准镜内置 1.7 m 身高曲线测距尺与电池照明分划板，令其在 30 发/分（半自动精准射速） 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 620 毫米身管与 7.62×54mmR 口径，德拉贡诺夫 SVD 半自动狙击步枪 实现了每秒 830 米的初速与 800 米有效射程。1970 年代起由 1:320 mm 改为 1:240 mm 缠距以兼顾 7N1 狙击弹与曳光穿甲弹，展现了卓越的工程平衡。

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 10 发容量的10 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与 38 mm 膛轴设计，德拉贡诺夫 SVD 半自动狙击步枪 将单发后坐冲量控制在 11.2 N·s 水平。镂空拇指孔木托配可拆皮质贴腮垫，4.3 kg 含镜全重极其轻盈机动。
如今在数字兵器库 3D 百年展厅（BAY-66）中，您可以随时通过三轴剖视、100% 爆炸视图与实时运动学滑块，零距离拆解这座跨越时代的机械工程杰作。
acts.audioScript: 第四幕，百年遗产。凭借 10 发容量的10 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与出色的整体工效，镂空拇指孔木托配可拆皮质贴腮垫，4.3 kg 含镜全重极其轻盈机动。欢迎在 BAY-66 展位亲手切开剖面、逐件拆解，感受 德拉贡诺夫 SVD 半自动狙击步枪 的机械魅力。

acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the Dragunov SVD
paragraphs: Introduced in 1963 by Izhmash in USSR, the Dragunov SVD emerged as a defining Semi-Automatic Designated Marksman Rifle. Adopted by the Soviet Army in 1963, the SVD was the first semi-automatic rifle purposefully fielded at the squad and platoon level to extend infantry reach past 600 meters.

Designed by Evgeny Dragunov, the SVD pioneered the modern Designated Marksman Rifle doctrine; unlike the AK, it uses an independent short-stroke piston and lightweight 3-lug rotating bolt paired with the 4×24 PSO-1 stadiametric optic out to 800 m. Measuring 1,225 mm (Skeletonized Wood Stock & Flash Hider) at an unloaded weight of 4.3 kg, it reshaped expectations across the Sniper Rifle class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 1963, Izhmash of USSR introduced the Dragunov SVD. Adopted by the Soviet Army in 1963, the SVD was the first semi-automatic rifle purposefully fielded at the squad and platoon level to extend infantry reach past 600 meters. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — Decoupled short-stroke piston and spring-returned pushrod slash reciprocating mass disruption — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the Dragunov SVD sits its Short-Stroke Gas Piston · 3-Lug Rotating Bolt with 2-Position Gas Regulator. Throughout every firing cycle, independent short-stroke piston delivers a clean impulse while isolating heat forward of the receiver, containing 390 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in blued forged ordnance steel paired with oil-finished walnut, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, Milled steel receiver and 3-lug rotating bolt lock up ruggedly with rimmed 7.62×54mmR rounds, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
acts.audioScript: Act Two: Core Mechanical Architecture. The Dragunov SVD relies on Short-Stroke Gas Piston · 3-Lug Rotating Bolt with 2-Position Gas Regulator. During each cycle, independent short-stroke piston delivers a clean impulse while isolating heat forward of the receiver. Machined from blued forged ordnance steel paired with oil-finished walnut, it delivers standout engineering reliability: Milled steel receiver and 3-lug rotating bolt lock up ruggedly with rimmed 7.62×54mmR rounds.

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for 7.62×54mmR with 620 mm Chrome-Lined CHF · 4-Groove RH Rifling (1:240 mm Twist), the Dragunov SVD develops 830 m/s muzzle velocity and 3,300 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 800 meters.

Internally, Updated from 1:320 mm to 1:240 mm twist in the 1970s to stabilize both 7N1 sniper loads and armor-piercing rounds. Combined with its 30 RPM (Practical Semi-Auto) tempo, Side-mounted 4×24 PSO-1 optic integrates a 1.7 m stadiametric rangefinder and illuminated reticle, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving 7.62×54mmR through its 620 millimeter bore, the Dragunov SVD achieves 830 meters per second and 800 meters of effective reach. Updated from 1:320 mm to 1:240 mm twist in the 1970s to stabilize both 7N1 sniper loads and armor-piercing rounds.

acts.title: Feed Philosophy, Ergonomics & Centennial Legacy
paragraphs: Fed by a 10-round 10-round detachable magazine body with a 38 mm bore-axis height, the platform manages 11.2 N-s of recoil impulse cleanly. Skeletonized thumbhole stock with clip-on cheek riser keeps scoped mass at just 4.3 kg.
Now archived in Digital Armory 3D Centennial Gallery (BAY-66), all 20 interactive assemblies can be sectioned live along three axes, exploded to 100%, and inspected part by part.
